song_craft: Victory-over-distress song (9v): melting-and-entry — same-sap drop (v1) → axe-on-root (v2) → melt-string (v3) → Mother-plump sky-goer (v4) → connoisseurship (v5) → jewel-sheds-sparks (v6) → station past waiting gods (v7, who open) → whirl-sight (v8, lens not dwelling) → mind-lad weds (v9, sons open). Frenzy praised, sobriety unrevoked.

lines: Come to same-sap in Thee, bliss-river —
may my mind drop in one go, Lord, this great disaster of difference-dependence.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tvayy ānandasarasvati samarasatām etya nātha mama cetaḥ pariharatu sakṛd iyantaṃ bhedādhīnaṃ mahānartham

lines: on passion-hate's fetter-hard root, Lord, may the axe fall within: certainty of Thee-made-oneness.

lines: Melt, thought-stain-string; sport, unboltedness, in heart.
Bliss-sap-flooded be my knowing-made form, Lord.
l4.sanskrit_cite: galatu vikalpakalaṅkāvalī samullasatu hṛdi nirargalatā bhagavann ānandarasaplutāstu me cinmayī mūrtiḥ

lines: O Thy-love-thought Mother, plump me with sap on sap, that wing-grown I turn sky-goer.
l4.sanskrit_cite: rāgādimayabhavāṇḍakaluṭhitaṃ tvadbhaktibhāvanāmbikā tais taiḥ āpyāyayatu rasair māṃ pravṛddhapakṣo yathā bhavāmi khagaḥ

lines: May this mind of mine win connoisseurship —
savoring Thy-foot-thought-nectar-sap's pith — till sense-poison-clinging hankers no more.
